intro: The Osaka table proves that great design comes in compact sizes. With its elegant finish, smart storage, and space-saving oval shape, it’s the perfect blend of style and function for modern living.

features.title: A Remini walnut finish
features.text: Showcases a timeless walnut shade with a matte finish, adding sophistication to any room.

features.title: Built to last, designed for everyday use
features.text: Crafted from 18mm prelaminated particle board, ensuring long-lasting sturdiness and reliability.

features.title: Easy-access storage for a clutter-free space
features.text: Features open storage accessible from both sides, keeping your essentials stylishly organised and within reach.

features.title: An oval design that fits anywhere
features.text: Space-efficient oval shape fits snugly into any setting, blending style and functionality effortlessly.

features.title: Simple setup, effortless convenience
features.text: Designed for hassle-free setup, the table comes flat-packed for convenience and portability.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
